Chapter 3 - Directory Numbers / Directory Number Reference
Directory Number Functions / Setting Do Not Disturb Modes

TELDNDClear

Clears the Do Not Disturb feature on a directory number, as implemented by the telephone network switch. 
pascal TELErr TELDNDClear (TELDNHandle hTELDN, short dndType);
hTELDN
A handle to the directory number structure for the directory number for which Do Not Disturb is being cleared.
dndType
The kind of Do Not Disturb being cleared. The section "Do Not Disturb Types" (page 3-12) describes the constants to which you can set this field.
function result
A result code.
DESCRIPTION
The TELDNDClear function clears the Do Not Disturb feature for the directory number specified by the hTELDN parameter. The type of Do Not Disturb feature to clear is specified by the dndType parameter.

SEE ALSO
To set the Do Not Disturb feature, call the TELDNDSet function (page 3-26).
